## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated (unit; property/sim tests for sync; fuzz target for any new parser)
- [ ] Docs updated (spec-affecting changes need a doc PR first; see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No secrets in logs/tests/fixtures; no new network calls; no new `unsafe`
- [ ] Threat-model checklist reviewed (docs/03 §7)
- [ ] New dependencies justified (maintenance, audit status, transitive size)
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
